evidence: Source review against native build 1: this ticket replaces external agent CLI bindings with selective wire contracts and explicit backend feature checks. Native HTTP routes, response serializers, conversation events, usage response models, executor protocol, iOS build middleware, and draft/outbox paths remain unchanged. The backend usage edit only replaces the internal Codex handshake model import. Existing error envelopes carry the new update guidance as ordinary backend failure text. Verification passed 95 focused unit cases, minimum/newest protocol qualifiers, and eight existing live adapter cases. Conversation API coverage includes backend update authority and retained response behavior. This preserves the existing native build floor. No signed-device, TestFlight, reconnect, or draft-survival checks ran for this ticket. Existing native push delivery proof still requires the operator release and replacement signed build.
